pattern_explanation: The Polish words and their English equivalents do not share the same meaning in every case. Some words come from the same Latin or Greek roots, so their spelling looks alike, but their everyday meanings have moved apart.
false_friend_warning: The Polish word sympatyczny looks like the English word sympathetic, but it means nice or friendly, not feeling pity for someone. Also, aktualnie means currently, not actually, and ewentualnie means possibly, not eventually.
